sponsored.t: Relates to providing information to patients and the public on hospital rule-based exclusions
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing information to patients and the public on hospital rule-based exclusions; requires the commissioner of health to collect from each hospital a list of its hospital rule-based exclusions and publish such information on the department's website.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 140 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 3486, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law and the insurance law, in relation to providing information to patients and the public on hospital rule-based exclusions" NOT APPROVED This bill would require the Department of Health (DOH) to annually collect from each general hospital a list of its rule-based exclusions, publish the list on the DOH website, and create standardized language for the list to ensure it is readily understandable. It would also require DOH to submit a report to the legislature regarding rule-based exclusions in the State and their impact on patients' ability to access care near their residences. The bill would further require hospitals to link to the DOH website on both their own websites and in their state- ments of patient rights…

sponsored.t: Requires the department of health to publish a report on the incidence of tick-borne illnesses annually on the department's website
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to publish a report on the incidence of tick-borne illnesses annually on the department's website; requires the department to submit an annual report to the governor and the leaders of the legislature; requires the superintendent of financial services to review the status of health insurance coverage for the treatment of Lyme disease and other tick-borne related diseases and to submit a report to the governor and the leaders of the legislature.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 81 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bills: Assembly Bill Number 33, entitled: "AN ACT in relation to establishing the task force to promote the employment of people with disabilities" Assembly Bill Number 468, entitled: "AN ACT directing the commissioner of motor vehicles to conduct a study of official inspection stations, safety inspections and fees" Assembly Bill Number 1988-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to establishing a center for technical assistance relating to age-friendly health systems; and in relation to hospital performance data" Assembly Bill Number 2468, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public service law, in relation to creating the state office of the utility consumer advocate" Assembly Bill Number 2497, entitled: "AN ACT establishing a fiscal cliff task force to conduct a…

sponsored.t: Permits the rendering of an estimated bill from a utility corporation or municipality under certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Permits the rendering of an estimated bill from a utility corporation or municipality under certain circumstances; requires each utility corporation and municipality within six months to submit to the commission a model for the calculation of and procedures for estimated bills that incorporates best practices and technology and accounts for any barriers to the use of actual meter readings.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 83 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 2182-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public service law, in relation to permitting the rendering of an estimated bill from a utility corporation or municipality under certain circumstances" NOT APPROVED This bill would prohibit a utility corporation or municipality from issuing an estimated bill for any consecutive billing period to a resi- dential customer unless certain circumstances are met and prohibit cost shifting to customers. The bill would also require utilities to file plans with the Public Service Commission ("PSC") to model the calcu- lation of estimated bills and require the PSC to promulgate regulations to govern the approval of such models. I support limiting the use of estimated bills in utility billing prac- tices to ensure customers only pay for…

sponsored.t: Establishes a state frontotemporal degeneration registry
sponsored.sum: Establishes a state frontotemporal degeneration registry; defines terms; requires every physician, nurse practitioner, nurse physician assistant and general hospital that diagnoses or is treating a patient diagnosed with an FTD disorder to give notice to the department; requires certain information to be confidential; sets forth the duties of the commissioner of health; requires the department of health to create and maintain a webpage.

sponsored.t: Exempts processors of syrup made from tree sap or honey from certain licensing requirements
sponsored.sum: Exempts processors of syrup made from tree sap or honey who do not purchase syrup made from tree sap or honey from others for repackaging, and who do not combine syrup made from tree sap or honey with any other ingredients capable of supporting the growth of infectious or toxigenic organisms from certain licensing requirements for food processing establishments.
sponsored.fis: This legislation will have no fiscal implications for State or local government.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Greene to impose an additional mortgage recording tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Greene to impose an additional mortgage recording tax.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization for imposition of additional sales and compensating use taxes in Greene county
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for imposition of additional sales and compensating use taxes in Greene county.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the county of Columbia to impose an additional 1 percent sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the county of Columbia to impose an additional 1 percent sales and compensating use tax by two years.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the county of Columbia to impose an additional real estate transfer tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the county of Columbia to impose an additional real estate transfer tax by two years.

sponsored.t: Specifies the occupancy tax in the village of Catskill shall only apply to hotels and motels
sponsored.sum: Specifies the occupancy tax in the village of Catskill shall only apply to hotels and motels.

sponsored.t: Relates to the occupancy tax in the village of Coxsackie
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the scope of the occupancy tax in the village of Coxsackie.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Copake to establish community preservation funds and to impose a real estate transfer tax with revenues to be deposited into the fund
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Copake to establish community preservation funds and to impose a real estate transfer tax with revenues to be deposited into the community preservation fund; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to retail food store, food service establishment and food warehouse licensing
sponsored.sum: Relates to retail food store, food service establishment and food warehouse licensing; defines terms; provides for licensure; authorizes the commissioner of agriculture and markets to grant, suspend or revoke licenses; authorizes civil practice law and rules article 78 proceedings to challenge the actions of such commissioner; authorizes such commissioner or such commissioner's duly authorized representatives to investigate and inspect such retail food stores or warehouses; requires the department of agriculture and markets to assign at least on retail food specialist to each inspection zone; provides for penalties and remedies; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Hurley to alienate certain lands used as parklands and to dedicate certain other lands as parklands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Hurley to alienate certain lands used as parklands for the purpose of constructing a new highway garage for the town and to dedicate certain other lands as parklands.

sponsored.t: Relates to the produce security fund
sponsored.sum: Provides that any time the produce security fund exceeds six million dollars on the one hundred twentieth day prior to the commencement of the next licensing year, the commissioner of agriculture and markets shall suspend the collection of the security fund fee; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the removal of actions to certain courts in an adjoining county
sponsored.sum: Allows the removal of criminal actions to a mental health court in an adjoining county.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions authorizing the city of Hudson to impose hotel and motel taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions authorizing the city of Hudson to impose hotel and motel taxes.
sponsored.fis: This will generate revenue for the City of Hudson.

sponsored.t: Relates to consideration of capital expenditures in rate proceedings
sponsored.sum: Requires that any proposed capital expenditure to be considered in any matter affecting a major change in rates must be described by the utility and shall include the purpose, cost, and benefits to the ratepayers and shall be posted on the PSC website.

sponsored.t: Defines therapeutic agriculture for the purposes of community gardens
sponsored.sum: Defines therapeutic agriculture for the purposes of community gardens as the use of agricultural activities as a means of promoting physical, mental and emotional well-being, rehabilitation and therapy for certain individuals.
sponsored.fis: This legislation will have no fiscal implications for State or Local governments.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage American shad
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage American shad until 12/31/2028.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage weakfish
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage weakfish until 12/31/2028.

sponsored.t: Includes consideration of evidence of recent acts of aggravated cruelty to animals as a factor to be considered when determining whether grounds for a temporary extreme risk protection order exist
sponsored.sum: Includes consideration of evidence of recent acts of aggravated cruelty to animals as a factor to be considered when determining whether grounds for a temporary extreme risk protection order exist.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the county of Ulster to impose an additional 1 percent sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the county of Ulster to impose an additional 1 percent sales and compensating use tax by two years.

sponsored.t: Relates to an exemption for certain property located in the county of Columbia from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a church
sponsored.sum: Relates to an exemption for certain property located in the county of Columbia from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a school or church.

sponsored.t: Provides for a partial exemption from taxation of certain residential real property transferred by a governmental entity, nonprofit housing organization, land bank or community land trust to low-income households
sponsored.sum: Provides for a partial exemption from taxation of certain residential real property transferred by a governmental entity, nonprofit housing organization, land bank or community land trust to low-income households; sets forth conditions for the discontinuance of such exemption.

sponsored.t: Relates to cannabis showcase event permits
sponsored.sum: Sets forth certain provisions for the sale of adult-use cannabis and adult-use cannabis products at cannabis showcase events; requires permittees to partner with cultivators in certain situations.

sponsored.t: Regulates short-term rentals
sponsored.sum: Amends a chapter of 2024 regulating short-term rentals; provides local option; provides for the collection of taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to vacancies on the council of the arts
sponsored.sum: Provides that upon a vacancy, the council of the arts shall not be deemed out of compliance with the requirement that each of the ten regions of the state be represented by at least one member of the council so long as such vacancy is filled within a reasonable time and the appointment made for such new vacancy moves the composition of the council closer to such requirement.

sponsored.t: Establishes an Alzheimer's disease outreach and education program
sponsored.sum: Removes the director of the office of the aging from deciding resources and information concerning Alzheimer's disease and any other dementia related matters; leaves such decisions to the commissioner of health.

sponsored.t: Expands the definition of crops, livestock and livestock products to include cannabis
sponsored.sum: Expands the definition of crops, livestock and livestock products to include cannabis when cultivated in accordance with the cannabis law; amends the effectiveness thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to types of New York grown, produced or harvested milk products included in the definition of surplus agricultural products for the purposes of the Nourish New York program
sponsored.sum: Relates to types of New York grown, produced or harvested milk products included in the definition of surplus agricultural products for the purposes of the Nourish New York program; directs that such term include New York grown, produced or harvested milk, and milk products, including but not limited to two percent fat milk and whole milk.

sponsored.t: Relates to recommendations of the traumatic brain injury services coordinating council
sponsored.sum: Sets the basis for recommendations of the traumatic brain injury services coordinating council; requires annual posting of such recommendations.
